description: This PHP source file manages database-backed sessions for the ADOdb library, including session data serialization, database table creation, session regeneration, reading, writing, destruction, and garbage collection. It defines the ADODB_Session class and related functions.

classes.name: ADODB_Session
classes.description: A class providing database connection management, session lifecycle handling, and configuration options for session storage within the ADOdb database abstraction layer.

methods.name: driver
methods.description: Get or set the database driver used for session storage.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Get or set the database host.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Get or set the database username.

methods.name: password
methods.description: Get or set the database password.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Get or set the database name.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Get or set the persistence mode for database connection.

methods.name: lifetime
methods.description: Get or set the session lifetime in seconds.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Enable or disable debugging output.

methods.name: expireNotify
methods.description: Get or set the expiration notification callback.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Get or set the name of the table storing session data.

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: Get or set whether to perform database optimization during garbage collection.

methods.name: syncSeconds
methods.description: Get or set the interval in seconds for server time synchronization.

methods.name: clob
methods.description: Get or set whether CLOB/BLOB data types are used.

methods.name: dataFieldName
methods.description: Get or set the database field name storing session data.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Get or set the filter objects applied to session data.

methods.name: encryptionKey
methods.description: Get or set the encryption key used for crypted sessions.

methods.name: _conn
methods.description: Get or set the current database connection object.

methods.name: _crc
methods.description: Get or set the stored CRC value for session data consistency.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initialize session handler registration.

methods.name: _sessionKey
methods.description: Generate the encryption key for crypted sessions.

methods.name: _dumprs
methods.description: Debug function to output session record sets.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Configure database connection parameters.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Open or reuse a database connection for session storage.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the database connection (stub).

methods.name: read
methods.description: Read session data for a given key from the database.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Write session data for a given key into the database.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Delete a session by key from the database.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Perform garbage collection to remove expired sessions.
